top_signals.title: Revolut’s Storonsky Says He’s Coming for JPMorgan’s US Crown
top_signals.summary: Revolut Ltd. Chief Executive Officer Nik Storonsky said he wants the digital bank to compete with firms including JPMorgan Chase & Co. and American Express Co. in the US, as well as hold a primary listing in the country if it chooses to pursue a public offering in the future.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
